text:
name: rag_knowledge_sources
question: >-
  Populate the knowledge base's second ingestion path — the code, code-quality, and policy
  knowledge that the finding-producer does not cover. The schema already anticipates it
  (KnowledgeRecord.source_type = code|report|policy, plus language/symbols fields), and the
  retrieval query planner already extracts code symbols/paths from work items, but the corpus is
  code-blind: graph.load_codebase_graph is orphaned (zero callers) and sonar.py / lsp_diagnostics.py /
  entropy.py feed post-hoc analysis but never the KB. This spec ingests those sources through the
  SAME pointer contract the finding-producer fix established, so the KB holds findings + code +
  quality + policy, not just findings.
version: "0.1"
workflow:
  kind: agent_task
  params:
    language: python
    fork: true
    context:
      brief: >-
        Builds ON TOP of the fixed producer contract (per-record JSON artifacts, content_hash =
        sha256(artifact), extract_record…
